## What we do

Quantex builds fast, clear websites that turn visitors into enquiries; AI assistants trained on a business's own information that answer customers on the website and WhatsApp and hand over to a person when needed; automation that removes repetitive work; custom software built around how a business operates; SEO that helps the right customers find you; and system design that plans the technology behind a growing business. The right tools are chosen for each project, and clients own everything that is built.

## How we work

- Plain language from the first call.
- You own your code, domain, accounts and content.
- Direct contact with the person doing the work, on WhatsApp or email.
- Replies within 24 hours.
